content.generalClinicalInformation: This clinical guideline discusses various studies and trials related to aortic disease management, focusing on endovascular and open repair methods for abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA) and thoracoabdominal aortic aneurysms. It examines long-term results, morbidity, mortality, and complication rates from different repair techniques. The guideline includes data from randomized controlled trials and systematic reviews to support clinical decision-making in selecting appropriate treatment strategies for patients with aneurysms.
